howSums: In each hive, one number is the sum of two others. Circle it, then write the addition sentence.
howTimes: In each hive, one number is the product of two others. Circle it, then write the multiplication sentence.
name: Name
tips: Put one hive on the board as a warm-up, let children solve it in pairs, and ask them to explain which two numbers they used.
Begin with an addition hive. Children can use counters or draw dots before writing a number sentence.
For multiplication, choose tables the class has already explored through equal groups and arrays.
A timer is optional. A clear explanation matters more than finishing first.
